detail: Installs a thin GitHub Actions workflow that calls the shared Code Linter in ForkHorizon/ci-gates, plus JSON limits. PR and merge queue runs scan changed files; manual and scheduled runs scan the whole repository.

files.contents:
name: {{script_title}}

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Files to scan
        required: false
        default: all
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - changed
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-scope-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  code-linter:
    uses: ForkHorizon/ci-gates/.github/workflows/code-linter.yml@main
    with:
      mode: ${{ inputs.mode || 'auto' }}
      config: .{{script_slug}}.json
      runs-on: '{{runner_labels_json}}'

pullRequestBody:
Adds {{script_title}} managed by CI Scope.

This PR adds:
- `.github/workflows/{{script_slug}}.yml`
- `.{{script_slug}}.json`

The workflow calls the shared Code Linter in `ForkHorizon/ci-gates`, so gate logic updates roll out from that repository automatically. It checks changed files on pull requests and merge queue runs, and scans the full repository on manual or scheduled runs.
